name: Mordechai Walder
abstract_title: Leveraging Aesthetic Chills-Inducing Stimuli to Augment Contemplative Practice: Evidence from Loving-Kindness Meditation and Prayer
abstract: Self-transcendent experiences (STE) during contemplative practice have been linked to various mental health benefits, yet reliably inducing such states remains challenging. We present two studies exploring whether chills-eliciting stimuli (e.g., powerful speeches, music) can enhance contemplative experiences and their downstream effects. authors: Mordechai Walder, Leonardo Christov-Moore Christov-Moore, Nicco Reggente, Felix Schoeller
